units.source_text: 时方行动轻便，很快到达了宇治山庄。

en.t: Tokikata traveled lightly and soon arrived at the Uji villa.

units.source_text: 其时雨势已稍停息，但因山路崎岖，他不得不穿简便服装，形似一个仆人。

en.t: By then the rain had eased a little, but because the mountain road was rough, he had to wear plain, practical clothes and looked like a servant.

units.source_text: 走进山庄，就听见许多人在喧嚷，有人说“今夜应当行个葬礼！”

en.t: When he entered the villa, he heard many people clamoring, and someone said, "The funeral should be held tonight!"

units.source_text: 时方一听吓呆了。

en.t: Tokikata was stunned with fright when he heard this.

units.source_text: 他要求和右近会面，但右近挡驾，叫人向他传言说：“现已茫然若失，不能起身。

en.t: He asked to meet Ukon, but Ukon refused to receive him and had someone tell him, "I am now so dazed with grief that I cannot rise.

units.source_text: 大夫驾临，今夜该是最后一次了。

en.t: Your visit tonight, my lord, is likely to be the last.

units.source_text: 失迎不胜抱歉。”

en.t: I am deeply sorry that I cannot come out to welcome you."

units.source_text: 时方说道：“如此说来，我不能探明情况，如何回去报命呢？

en.t: Tokikata said, "If that is so, how can I go back and report when I have not learned what happened?

units.source_text: 至少那位侍从姐姐总得出来和我一见。”

en.t: At the very least, Lady Jijū must come out and meet me."

units.source_text: 他恳切请求，侍从只得出来和他会面，对他说道：“真是万万想不到啊！

en.t: He pleaded so earnestly that Jijū had no choice but to come out and meet him, and she said, "This is truly beyond anything we could have imagined!

units.source_text: 小姐之死，仿佛她自己也不曾预料到的。

en.t: The young lady's death seems to have been something even she herself never expected.

units.source_text: 请你转告亲王：我们这里的人说悲伤也好，说什么也好，总之全像做梦一般，茫然不知所措了。

en.t: Please tell the Prince that all of us here, whether one calls it sorrow or anything else, feel as if this were a dream and are utterly bewildered.

units.source_text: 且待心情稍稍安静之后，当把小姐近来愁闷之状，以及亲王来访那夜她的痛苦情况一一奉告。

en.t: When our hearts have calmed a little, we will tell him in detail about the young lady's recent melancholy and her suffering on the night the Prince visited.

units.source_text: 丧家不吉，等到四十九日忌辰过后，请大夫再来晤谈。”

en.t: A house in mourning is inauspicious, so after the forty-ninth day memorial has passed, please come again to speak with us."

units.source_text: 说罢啜泣不止。

en.t: After saying this, she kept sobbing without stop.

units.source_text: 内室中也只听见许多人的哭声。

en.t: From the inner rooms too, all that could be heard was the sound of many people weeping.

units.source_text: 其中有一人在嚷，大约是乳母吧：“我的小姐啊！

en.t: Among them one person was crying out, probably the nurse: "My dear young lady!

units.source_text: 你到哪里去了？

en.t: Where have you gone?

units.source_text: 快点回来呀！

en.t: Please come back quickly!

units.source_text: 连尸骨也看不见，叫我好伤心啊！

en.t: I cannot even see your remains, and it breaks my heart!

units.source_text: 往日里朝夕相见，还嫌不够亲近。

en.t: In the past I saw you morning and evening, and even that never felt close enough.

units.source_text: 我日日夜夜盼望小姐交运纳福，因此我这条老命也得延长到今天。

en.t: Day and night I hoped that good fortune and happiness would come to you, and that is why this old life of mine lasted until today.

units.source_text: 想不到小姐忽然抛弃了我，连去向也不得而知。

en.t: I never thought you would suddenly abandon me, and now I do not even know where you have gone.

units.source_text: 鬼神不敢夺我的小姐。

en.t: No spirit or demon would dare take my young lady away.

units.source_text: 大家所深惜的人，帝释天也会让她还魂。

en.t: For someone everyone cherishes so deeply, even Indra would surely let her soul return.

units.source_text: 夺取我家小姐的人，不论是人或者是鬼，都该快快把她还给我们！

en.t: Whoever took our young lady, whether human or spirit, should return her to us at once!

units.source_text: 至少也得让我们看看她的遗骸。”

en.t: At least let us see her remains."

units.source_text: 她一五一十地哭诉。

en.t: She poured out every detail through her tears.

units.source_text: 时方听见其中有尸骨不见等话，觉得奇怪，便对侍从说道：“还请你把实情告诉我。

en.t: When Tokikata heard talk of the remains being missing, he found it strange and said to Jijū, "Please tell me the truth.

units.source_text: 或许是有人把她隐藏了吧？

en.t: Could someone perhaps have hidden her away?

units.source_text: 亲王要知道确实情况，我是代替他来的，是他派来的使者。

en.t: The Prince wants to know the true situation; I have come in his place as the messenger he sent.

units.source_text: 现在不论是死亡或是被人隐藏，总是没有办法的了。

en.t: At this point, whether she is dead or has been hidden by someone, nothing can be done.

units.source_text: 但倘日后水落石出，而实情与我今天回去报告的不符，亲王定会向我这使者问罪。

en.t: But if the truth comes out later and differs from the report I take back today, the Prince will surely hold me, his messenger, to account.

units.source_text: 亲王以为虽然事已如此，或许传闻失实，尚有一线希望，

en.t: The Prince thought that even though matters had come to this, perhaps the rumors were false and there was still a thread of hope,

units.source_text: 所以特派我来向你们面询，这岂不是一番好意么？

en.t: and so he specially sent me to question you in person. Is that not an act of goodwill?

units.source_text: 耽好女色之事，在中国古代朝廷里也不乏其例。

en.t: There were certainly examples of men indulging in love affairs even in the ancient courts of China.

units.source_text: 但像我们亲王那样一往情深，我看是世间所没有的。”

en.t: But I do not think there is anyone in the world as devoted and deeply feeling as our Prince."

units.source_text: 侍从想道：“这真是个亲切的使者！

en.t: Jijū thought, "What a kind messenger he is!

units.source_text: 我即使想隐瞒，这种世无其例的大事情将来自会揭穿的。”

en.t: Even if I tried to hide it, an unparalleled matter like this would eventually come to light on its own."

units.source_text: 便答道：“大夫疑心有人隐藏小姐，如果略有一点儿可能，我们这里的人为什么个个如此悲伤哭泣呢？

en.t: So she answered, "My lord suspects that someone has hidden the young lady, but if there were even the slightest possibility of that, why would every one of us here be grieving and weeping so bitterly?

units.source_text: 实在是我家小姐近来非常忧愁苦闷，为此，薰大将说了她几句。

en.t: The truth is that our young lady had lately been deeply sorrowful and distressed, and General Kaoru said a few words to her about it.

units.source_text: 小姐的母亲和这个高声哭喊的乳母，都忙着做准备，让她迁居到最初结缘的薰大将那里去。

en.t: Her mother and this nurse who is crying so loudly were both busy making preparations for her to move to General Kaoru, with whom she had first been bound by fate.

units.source_text: 亲王的事情，小姐绝不让人知道，只在自己胸中感激思慕，因此她心情异常烦恼。

en.t: As for the Prince, the young lady never let anyone know, but kept her gratitude and longing for him in her own heart, and so she was tormented beyond measure.

units.source_text: 万没想到她自己会起舍身赴死的念头，所以我们如此悲伤，那乳母怪声怪气地哭喊不住。”

en.t: We never imagined that she herself would think of giving up her life, so we are grieving like this, and that nurse keeps wailing in such a strange voice."

units.source_text: 这话虽不详尽，总算把事实约略说明了。

en.t: Although these words were not detailed, they did at least give a rough account of the facts.

units.source_text: 时方还是难于置信，说道：“那么，以后再见吧。

en.t: Tokikata still found it hard to believe, and said, "Then let us meet again later.

units.source_text: 我们立谈片刻，实在太不详尽。

en.t: This brief conversation while standing here is far too incomplete.

units.source_text: 将来亲王定当亲自来访。”

en.t: The Prince will surely come himself in due course."

units.source_text: 侍从答道：“唉，那是不敢当。

en.t: Jijū answered, "Ah, that would be more than we could accept.

units.source_text: 小姐与亲王的姻缘，现在如果被世人知道了，对已故的小姐说来，倒是光荣幸运之事。

en.t: If the bond between the young lady and the Prince became known to the world now, it would in fact be an honor and blessing for the late young lady.

units.source_text: 然而此事一向严守秘密，所以现在还是不可泄露，这才不负死者的遗志。”

en.t: But this matter has always been kept strictly secret, so it still must not be revealed; only then will we honor the wish of the dead."

units.source_text: 这里的人都在尽力设法，务使这不寻常的横死事件勿让外人知道。

en.t: Everyone there was doing everything possible to keep outsiders from learning of this extraordinary sudden death.

units.source_text: 时方倘在这里久留，自会被人看出情由，因此侍从劝时方早点离去。

en.t: If Tokikata stayed there long, people would naturally see what was going on, so Jijū urged him to leave quickly.

units.source_text: 时方就走了。

en.t: Tokikata then left.
